newsitem.title: JAPAN: HANDBALL-RUSSIA END PRELIMINARY ROUND UNDEFEATED.
newsitem.headline: HANDBALL-RUSSIA END PRELIMINARY ROUND UNDEFEATED.

text.p: Russia, fuelled by seven goals each from Valeri Gopin and Dmitry Torgovanov, beat Olympic champions Croatia 31-20 on Sunday to secure the only undefeated record at the end of the preliminary round of the men's world handball championship.
The Russians go into the final round starting on Tuesday as favourites for the title after they swept through their five matches, piling up 150 points and conceding only 84.
The top four teams from each of the four preliminary groups advance to the championship knock-out round.
The quarter-finals will be played on Thursday, with the semifinals and final played next weekend.
The teams contesting the final round are Iceland, Yugoslavia, Lithuania, Japan, France, Sweden, South Korea, Norway, Spain, Egypt, Czech Republic, Tunisia, Russia, Hungary, Cuba, Croatia.
